$comment: Mechanical id translation for ATLAS ids that no longer exist in the pinned release (mappings/mitre_atlas.json). Applied by scripts/merge_and_dedupe.py::fill_taxonomy to every entry's mitre_atlas, BEFORE tactics are derived. Curated by hand; scripts/lint_atlas_ids.py fails if a translation target is itself absent/deprecated, and the monthly refresh report lists every removed id that has no translation here (those need a human decision; do not guess). The mapping HEURISTICS that emit the old ids (LLM_TO_ATLAS etc.) are deliberately untouched (label-scientist territory); this table only keeps their output valid against the pinned release.

AML.T0019.basis: ATLAS 2026.07 (verified; also absent in 2026.08 and 2026.09) replaced 'Publish Poisoned Datasets' (AML.T0019) with AML.T0115 'Publish Poisoned AI Artifacts', subtechnique AML.T0115.000 'Datasets'. Same tactic (AML.TA0003) on both sides.

AML.T0058.basis: ATLAS 2026.07 onward: 'Publish Poisoned Models' (AML.T0058) became AML.T0115.001 'Models' under AML.T0115 'Publish Poisoned AI Artifacts'. Same tactic (AML.TA0003) on both sides.

AML.T0104.basis: ATLAS 2026.07 onward: 'Publish Poisoned AI Agent Tool' (AML.T0104) became AML.T0115.002 'AI Agent Tools' under AML.T0115. Same tactic (AML.TA0003) on both sides.

AML.T0015.001.basis: AML.T0015.001 is not defined in ATLAS 2026.06 or 2026.09 (AML.T0015 'Evade AI Model' has no subtechniques); it entered the corpus via the AVID ingest. Mapped to its parent, the conservative choice. Pre-existing defect surfaced by the refresh lint, not caused by the 2026.09 release.

AML.T0024.000.basis: ATLAS v2026.10 release notes (github.com/mitre-atlas/atlas-data releases, tag v2026.10): 'Training Data Information from AI Models: Infer Membership' (AML.T0137.000) is 'moved from Exfiltration via AI Inference API: Infer Training Data Membership (AML.T0024.000)'. Tactic coverage of the target is inherited from AML.T0137 (derived at merge).

AML.T0024.001.basis: ATLAS v2026.10 release notes (github.com/mitre-atlas/atlas-data releases, tag v2026.10): 'Training Data Information from AI Models: Invert AI Model' (AML.T0137.002) is 'moved from Exfiltration via AI Inference API: Invert AI Model (AML.T0024.001)'.

AML.T0056.basis: ATLAS v2026.10 release notes (github.com/mitre-atlas/atlas-data releases, tag v2026.10): 'Data from AI Services: System Instructions' (AML.T0085.003) is 'moved from Extract LLM System Prompt (AML.T0056)'. Tactic changes Exfiltration (AML.TA0010) -> Collection (AML.TA0009) with the move; declared in the 2026-10-29 delta.

AML.T0057.basis: ATLAS v2026.10 release notes (github.com/mitre-atlas/atlas-data releases, tag v2026.10): 'Data from AI Services: Conversation Context and Memory' (AML.T0085.002) is 'moved from LLM Data Leakage (AML.T0057)'. Tactic changes Exfiltration (AML.TA0010) -> Collection (AML.TA0009) with the move; declared in the 2026-10-29 delta.

AML.T0024.002.basis: No successor stated in the ATLAS v2026.10 release notes (AML.T0024.000 and AML.T0024.001 were moved to AML.T0137.x; 'Extract AI Model' was not). Mapped to the still-defined parent AML.T0024 'Exfiltration via AI Inference API' (tactic AML.TA0010, defined in the 2026.10 YAML) as a conservative generalisation (AML.T0015.001 -> AML.T0015 precedent). Semantic re-target pending label-scientist review (D149).
